adaptation_status: Original playable SNES adaptation; earlier FF7 source archive not recovered

world.energy: Aether drawn from stored human memory

messages.title:
ASH & AETHER
THE UNFINISHED SONG
A city burns its memories.
A road begins beyond its walls.
messages.briefing:
ROOK: Orison feeds the city
with stolen memories.
Tonight, Furnace Nine stops.
We bring its workers home.
messages.sable:
SABLE: I was their guard.
I know the access route.
I am not here for a speech.
Tell me where to cut power.
messages.iona:
IONA: That core holds people,
not fuel. Break the machine,
not the lives inside it.
I will keep us standing.
messages.departure:
Furnace Nine: service gate.
Enter the works?
  Begin the mission
  Stay at the hideout
messages.security:
ORISON SECURITY
Unauthorized memory transfer.
Sentinel deployment approved.
messages.fight:
ROOK: Guard the wounded.
Break its iron shell.
Work together. Keep moving!
messages.victory:
The sentinel falls silent.
A path to the core is open.
Recovered: 250 credits.
messages.core:
Memories move in the glass.
Somebody is still singing.
Choose the crew's discipline:
  Sever / Shelter
messages.sever:
SABLE: I will cut a way
through the line.
Learned: Edge Wave
A ranged blade technique.
messages.shelter:
IONA: We turn the current
against its own machines.
Learned: Frost Lance
A focused ice technique.
messages.return:
ROOK: The core is ours.
The workers made it out.
Return to the Kiln?
  Return / Remain
messages.complete:
THE UNFINISHED SONG
The choir has fallen silent.
The city keeps its choices.
The roads remain open.
